gloss: to moisten; to enrich; to benefit

definitions.explanation: to add moisture to something dry

definitions.gloss: to enrich; to benefit; to profit
definitions.explanation: to provide wealth, comfort, or benefit to someone or something

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}が{大地|だいち}を{潤|うるお}す。
{乾燥|かんそう}した{肌|はだ}を{潤|うるお}す。
{心|こころ}を{潤|うるお}す{音楽|おんがく}。
{地域経済|ちいきけいざい}を{潤|うるお}す{観光業|かんこうぎょう}。
examples.english: Tourism that enriches the local economy.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
Intransitive pair: {潤|うるお}う

SENSE 1 (Physical):
- {肌|はだ}/{唇|くちびる}/{喉|のど}を{潤|うるお}す (to moisten skin/lips/throat)
- Used in skincare context

SENSE 2 (Figurative):
- {懐|ふところ}を{潤|うるお}す (to profit, make money - lit. to moisten one's pocket)
- {心|こころ}/{生活|せいかつ}を{潤|うるお}す (to enrich one's heart/life)

RELATED:
- {潤|うるお}う (to be moist; to profit - intransitive)
- {潤|うるお}い (moisture; benefit - noun)
- {湿|しめ}らす (to dampen)
- {渇|かわ}く (to be thirsty/dry - antonym of うるおう)
